description: Suites accepted in leaderboard submissions (submissions/README.md) and how the leaderboard uses them. role: functions or queries = scored in that category; reference = shown, not scored. mode: the run mode a function report must record. The hash of each suite's files is computed from this repository (scripts/submissions.py); a submission must have been run on the current files. reservedEngineNames: engines run by this repository's CI; submissions cannot use these names.
